name: Customer Support Ticket Routing with NLP

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO support_tickets_log (
  email_id,
  sender_email,
  subject,
  category,
  category_confidence,
  sentiment,
  sentiment_score,
  priority,
  zendesk_ticket_id,
  auto_response_sent,
  escalated,
  created_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.email_id }}',
  '{{ $json.sender_email }}',
  '{{ $json.subject }}',
  '{{ $json.category }}',
  {{ $json.category_confidence }},
  '{{ $json.sentiment }}',
  {{ $json.sentiment_score }},
  '{{ $json.priority }}',
  '{{ $json.zendesk_ticket_id }}',
  {{ $json.auto_response_needed }},
  {{ $json.escalation_needed }},
  NOW()
)

parameters.content:
## Customer Support Ticket Routing

**AI-Powered Features:**
- Automatic categorization using BART-large-MNLI
- Sentiment analysis with DistilBERT
- Smart priority assignment
- Auto-routing to correct Zendesk queues

**Categories:**
- Technical Support
- Billing Questions
- Account Issues
- Feature Requests
- Bug Reports
- General Inquiry
- Complaints
- Refund Requests

**Setup:**
- Gmail API with OAuth2
- Hugging Face API token
- Zendesk API credentials
- Slack workspace
- PostgreSQL database
